title: Three Burnt Bridges To A STRANGER 🌉
description:
In this town every friendship builds a little bridge between two windows, one plank at a time. Burn it, and you both forget the other one ever lived.

Three burnt bridges lie in the alley under my window, all running to the window of a guy I've never met. Somebody over there has forgotten me three times.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
